title: ApexFabric Surveillance Analytics Event V1
description: Analytics-event contract for the surveillance-edge-runtime pack. Only face_recognition and face_enrollment are specified here; reid/intrusion/people_counting have no event contract yet and are intentionally left out of the event_type enum below until whoever implements them defines one. The edge never assigns a person_id and never carries a local face gallery — it only extracts and emits normalized embeddings; identity resolution (matching against previously seen people, and auto-enrolling new ones) is entirely a central-plane responsibility over the vector DB. Embeddings in this payload are for that internal central-plane store only: never copy them into metrics, logs, or alert payloads (see LLD_PLAN.md section 14 and section 17 on treating faces/embeddings as sensitive business data confined to this versioned, access-controlled event path). Raw base64 face/body crops and other non-embedding biometric templates must still never appear in payload — subject.bbox plus a cropped snapshot_assets entry is the only visual evidence a client needs.

embedding_vector.description: L2-normalized (unit-norm) float embedding so the control plane can treat cosine similarity as a plain dot product. Dimension is fixed by the deployed model version and must be identical across every camera feeding the same deployment's vector DB; the control plane rejects (does not silently truncate or pad) any vector whose length does not match the dimension already established for this deployment.

face.description: Face embedding for the cropped subject.bbox region.

body.description: Whole-person re-identification embedding for the same tracked subject, used by central-plane matching when the face is briefly occluded or angled away; only emitted by face_recognition, never by face_enrollment.

quality.description: Capture-quality signal for the emitted embedding. The central plane may prefer a higher-quality observation when merging repeated sightings of the same resolved person, but it never blocks matching or auto-enrollment on these scores alone.
